formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x1 → (∀ (x3 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool), (x1.wires (List.ofFn x3)).getD (9 : ℕ) Bool.false = (x3 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x3 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)))) → ∃ (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x4 ∧ x4.size + (1 : ℕ) = x1.size ∧ ∀ (x5 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool), x4.eval (List.ofFn x5 ++ [x5 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ))]) = x1.eval (List.ofFn x5)
plain_statement: A circuit of AND, OR (two-input) and NOT gates on 9 inputs whose first gate computes AND(x_0, x_4). Then a circuit of the same kind with one gate fewer, given the nine inputs and the wire AND(x_0, x_4), computes the same function.
title: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no AND, OR (fan-in two), NOT circuit with at most 15 gates and first gate AND(x_0, x_4) computes its edge function
